meta.name: spark-optimization
meta.description: Optimize Apache Spark jobs with partitioning, caching, shuffle optimization, and memory tuning. Use when improving Spark performance, debugging slow jobs, or scaling data processing pipelines.

copy.tagline: 优化大数据处理作业的性能与资源占用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的数据作业常因Spark性能问题而卡顿或烧钱。
copy.tagline_en: Speed up Spark jobs and lower resource usage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Spark pipelines and often face slow jobs or high resource bills.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会提供 Apache Spark 作业的优化方案:包括启用自适应执行(AQE)、合理设置分区、调整内存与执行器配置、减少 shuffle 和应对数据倾斜等,并会给出可运行的代码示例。
howto.when: 当你要调试运行缓慢的 Spark 作业、调整内存与执行器配置,或需要为大规模数据管道设计高效分区与 shuffle 策略时,本技能会触发。

say.text: 我的Spark作业很慢,帮我分析怎么优化。
say.note: Claude 会给出具体的调优方向和配置。

say.text: 帮我配置Spark会话,开启AQE和Kryo序列化。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的构建代码。

say.text: 数据倾斜严重,应该加盐还是用广播连接?
say.note: Claude 会解释并给出实现方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude provides optimization guidance for Apache Spark jobs: enabling adaptive query execution, right-sizing partitions, tuning memory and executor configs, reducing shuffle, and addressing data skew, with runnable code examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are debugging slow Spark jobs, tuning memory or executor settings, or designing efficient partitioning and shuffle strategies for large-scale data pipelines.

say_en.text: My Spark job is slow. Help me analyze how to optimize it.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest specific tuning directions and configs.

say_en.text: Help me configure a Spark session with AQE and Kryo serialization.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the builder code.

say_en.text: My data is skewed. Should I use salting or broadcast joins?
say_en.note: Claude will explain and provide implementation.
